text:
Raul bought a house on 1 January 2024.
On 1 January 2025 the value of the house increased by 8%.
On 1 January 2026 the value of the house increased by 5% of its value on 1 January 2025.
The value of the house on 1 January 2026 was $90 720.

content.html: Calculate the amount Raul paid for the house on 1 January 2024.
content.text: Calculate the amount Raul paid for the house on 1 January 2024.

parts.label: b
parts.text:
From 2026 the value of the house increases exponentially at the rate of 5% each year.
The value of the house on 1 January 2026 was $90 720.
Find the year in which the value of the house on 1 January will first be greater than $200 000.
